result.summary: Overall the page is well-structured, but the promotional banner has a serious contrast problem: white text on a pale mint-green background is hard to read, and the 'Order now' button nearly disappears against the banner. A few minor contrast improvements are also possible.

issues.description: The promo banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and body text 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white text on a very light mint-green background, giving extremely low contrast and poor readability.
issues.suggestion: Change the banner text to a dark color (e.g., the app's dark green/near-black), or darken the banner background so white text meets WCAG AA contrast requirements.

issues.description: The 'Order now' button is a white pill on a pale mint-green banner, so the button shape has almost no visible boundary and appears to blend into the background.
issues.suggestion: Add a border, shadow, or make the button a solid dark/green fill so it clearly stands out as a tappable element.

issues.description: The 'See all' links use light green text on white, which may be below recommended contrast for small text.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker shade of the brand green for link text to improve legibility.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel cuts off the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the screen edge with no visible scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle peek of the next card, page dots, or edge fade to hint at horizontal scrolling.
